mechanism: Chlorthalidone increases simvastatin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and may potentiate statin myopathy risk through electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and volume depletion.
action: Monitor for myopathy symptoms; consider alternative statin (pravastatin/rosuvastatin are CYP3A4-independent); monitor electrolytes and renal function regularly.
